Container.Name: astris
Container.Overview: Private, self-hosted household money and shopping hub. Import bank statements, budgets, bills, savings goals, pantry and shopping lists, shared within your household. Everything stays on your server. All-in-one: includes its own database.

Config.Name: AppData
Config.Description: Everything Astris keeps: its database, daily backups (backups/), generated passwords (secrets.env)

Config.Name: Admin email
Config.Description: Your email: the account you register with this address becomes the server admin

Config.Name: Backup passphrase
Config.Description: Optional: encrypts backups. Keep it safe; without it a backup can't be restored.

Config.Name: Encryption key
Config.Description: Optional: encrypts kept statement/receipt files, notification secrets and calendar links. Make one with: docker exec astris python -m app.crypto new-key. Keep a copy in your password manager.

Config.Name: HTTPS
Config.Description: self-signed: https with the server's own certificate so phones can scan barcodes with the live camera. Install https://YOUR-SERVER:PORT/ca.crt on each phone once.

Config.Name: HTTPS addresses
Config.Description: With HTTPS on: the address(es) you open Astris with, comma-separated, e.g. 192.168.1.20,tower.local

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the app runs as (Unraid: 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the app runs as (Unraid: 100 = users)

Config.Name: Allow new sign-ups
Config.Description: Turn off once everyone in your home has an account (also switchable in the app)

Config.Name: External database host (optional)
Config.Description: Leave empty for the built-in database. Only if you'd rather use your own PostgreSQL container: its host, plus the three settings below.
